scope: Opening reading suggestions only; no refresh of the complete article evidence inventory.
policy: Relevant 2024–2026 formal publications or first-posted preprints; citation influence and scope jointly considered; recent low-citation papers labelled as supplements; no claim of exhaustive highest-cited ranking.

driving-3dgs-review-2025.title: Scene reconstruction techniques for autonomous driving: a review of 3D Gaussian splatting
driving-3dgs-review-2025.authors: Huixin Zhu, Zhili Zhang, Junyang Zhao, Hui Duan, Yao Ding, Xiongwu Xiao, Junsong Yuan
driving-3dgs-review-2025.readingNote: 面向驾驶场景，串起高斯渲染、新视角合成、场景理解和 SLAM。适合从通用 3DGS 转到道路应用；4D 在文中主要作为后续方向讨论。

representation-centric-4d-survey-2026.title: Reconstructing the Dynamic World: A Representation-Centric View of 4D Scene Reconstruction
representation-centric-4d-survey-2026.authors: Ziren Gong, Guo Chen, Yongjia Li, Yihua Shao, Fabio Tosi, Stefano Mattoccia, Matteo Poggi, Hao Tang, Fei Ma, Shuyan Li, Ziyang Yan, Nicu Sebe, Ling Shao, Jianfei Cai, Qi Tian, Ming-Hsuan Yang
representation-centric-4d-survey-2026.readingNote: 近期补充：比较规范空间形变、显式四维表示和逐帧优化，重点看时间如何进入场景表示。主要覆盖逐场景优化的 4D NeRF 与 4DGS。

gs-survey-2026.title: A Survey on 3D Gaussian Splatting
gs-survey-2026.readingNote: 系统介绍高斯光栅化、参数优化和密度控制，再展开稀疏输入、压缩、画质与动态重建。期刊版虽发表于 2026 年，主体仍梳理 2023—2024 年的早期发展，适合打基础。

gs-advances-2024.title: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian splatting
gs-advances-2024.authors: Tong Wu, Yu-Jie Yuan, Ling-Xiao Zhang, Jie Yang, Yan-Pei Cao, Ling-Qi Yan, Lin Gao
gs-advances-2024.readingNote: 按重建、编辑和应用整理高斯技术，适合查找动态重建、压缩与物理仿真的早期路线，与前面的原理综述互补。

radar-representations-survey-2025.title: Exploring Radar Data Representations in Autonomous Driving: A Comprehensive Review
radar-representations-survey-2025.authors: Shanliang Yao, Runwei Guan, Zitian Peng, Chenhang Xu, Yilu Shi, Weiping Ding, Eng Gee Lim, Yong Yue, Hyungjoon Seo, Ka Lok Man, Jieming Ma, Xiaohui Zhu, Yutao Yue
radar-representations-survey-2025.readingNote: 沿 ADC、雷达张量、点云、栅格和微多普勒五类表示，比较保留的信息与计算代价。适合理解雷达输入为什么影响下游任务；2025 年修订版主要整理 2019—2024 年的方法。

radar-perception-review-2026.title: 4D Radar Perception Algorithms for Autonomous Driving: A Review
radar-perception-review-2026.authors: Xumin Wu, Jun Zhou, Jilin Mei, Chen Min, Yu Hu
radar-perception-review-2026.readingNote: 近期补充：从检测和运动估计延伸到占据、动态重建，区分雷达单模态、传感器融合和跨模态监督。正文检索截止到 2026 年 8 月。

occupancy-survey-2025.title: A survey on occupancy perception for autonomous driving: The information fusion perspective
occupancy-survey-2025.authors: Huaiyuan Xu, Junliang Chen, Shiyu Meng, Yi Wang, Lap-Pui Chau
occupancy-survey-2025.readingNote: 按 LiDAR、视觉和多模态输入梳理占据预测，重点比较二维到三维变换、时序融合和监督来源。适合建立方法分类，阅读时留意各数据集的可见区域与标签设置。

vision-occupancy-review-2025.title: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction in autonomous driving: a review and outlook
vision-occupancy-review-2025.authors: Yanan Zhang, Jinqing Zhang, Zengran Wang, Junhao Xu, Di Huang
vision-occupancy-review-2025.readingNote: 聚焦视觉占据预测，用特征增强、计算效率和标签效率三条线组织方法。适合对照 BEV、TPV、体素表示，以及免标注、免 LiDAR 监督的区别。

vla-survey-2025.title: A Survey on Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
vla-survey-2025.authors: Sicong Jiang, Zilin Huang, Kangan Qian, Ziang Luo, Tianze Zhu, Yang Zhong, Yihong Tang, Menglin Kong, Yunlong Wang, Siwen Jiao, Hao Ye, Zihao Sheng, Xin Zhao, Tuopu Wen, Zheng Fu, Sikai Chen, Kun Jiang, Diange Yang, Seongjin Choi, Lijun Sun
vla-survey-2025.readingNote: 从视觉编码、语言处理到动作解码梳理 VLA，比较解释型、模块化、统一端到端和推理增强路线。适合接着看各类系统如何评测语言输出与驾驶行为。

vlm-driving-survey-2024.title: Vision Language Models in Autonomous Driving: A Survey and Outlook
vlm-driving-survey-2024.authors: Xingcheng Zhou, Mingyu Liu, Ekim Yurtsever, Bare Luka Zagar, Walter Zimmer, Hu Cao, Alois C. Knoll
vlm-driving-survey-2024.readingNote: 按感知、导航、决策、控制和数据生成整理视觉语言模型的用途，适合建立任务地图。它反映的是 2024 年的技术阶段，后续 VLA 发展可接着读上面的综述。

e2e-survey-2024.title: End-to-End Autonomous Driving: Challenges and Frontiers
e2e-survey-2024.authors: Li Chen, Penghao Wu, Kashyap Chitta, Bernhard Jaeger, Andreas Geiger, Hongyang Li
e2e-survey-2024.readingNote: 连接模仿学习、强化学习和规划导向表征，集中解释开环与闭环评测、因果混淆和分布偏移。适合先建立算法脉络，再阅读训练生态的近期整理。

e2e-training-ecosystem-survey-2026.title: A Survey on End-to-End Autonomous Driving Training From the Perspectives of Data, Strategy, and Platform
e2e-training-ecosystem-survey-2026.authors: Chengkai Xu, Yiming Cui, Jiaqi Liu, Yicheng Guo, Cheng Qin, Geyuan Zhang, Xinwei Dong, Shiyu Fang, Peng Hang, Jian Sun
e2e-training-ecosystem-survey-2026.readingNote: 近期补充：从数据、学习策略和训练平台三层组织端到端驾驶训练，补上数据治理与基础设施。适合梳理训练系统的组成，文中没有统一预算下的方案排名。

world-models-survey-2024.title: World Models for Autonomous Driving: An Initial Survey
world-models-survey-2024.authors: Yanchen Guan, Haicheng Liao, Zhenning Li, Jia Hu, Runze Yuan, Yunjian Li, Guohui Zhang, Chengzhong Xu
world-models-survey-2024.readingNote: 先理解感知、记忆、动作与世界模型的关系，再进入场景生成和规划控制。适合作为术语与路线入门，覆盖的是实时交互模型兴起前的阶段。

world-models-survey-2025.title: A Survey of World Models for Autonomous Driving
world-models-survey-2025.authors: Tuo Feng, Wenguan Wang, Yi Yang
world-models-survey-2025.readingNote: 按未来场景生成、行为规划、预测与规划交互三层组织文献，横向看图像、BEV、占据和点云表示。适合把分散的方法放回各自的任务与评测设置。

v2x-perception-survey-2025.title: Vehicle-to-Everything Cooperative Perception for Autonomous Driving
v2x-perception-survey-2025.authors: Tao Huang, Jianan Liu, Xi Zhou, Dinh C. Nguyen, Mostafa Rahimi Azghadi, Yuxuan Xia, Qing-Long Han, Sumei Sun
v2x-perception-survey-2025.readingNote: 从融合的数学表达出发，串起主体选择、信息压缩、时空对齐和特征融合。2025 年修订版适合建立协同感知的方法地图，重点仍在感知与通信。

collaborative-datasets-survey-2024.title: Collaborative Perception Datasets in Autonomous Driving: A Survey
collaborative-datasets-survey-2024.authors: Melih Yazgan, Mythra Varun Akkanapragada, J. Marius Zöllner
collaborative-datasets-survey-2024.readingNote: 对照路口、车车和车路数据集的传感器、标注与任务设置，适合选数据和设计基准。它提供 2024 年的数据集概况，后续新增基准见正文。

maead-survey-2026.title: Multi-Agent Embodied Autonomous Driving (MAEAD): From V2X Information Exchange to Shared World Models
maead-survey-2026.authors: Senkang Hu, Zhengru Fang, Yihang Tao, Zihan Fang, Yiqin Deng, Yuguang Fang
maead-survey-2026.readingNote: 近期补充：把共享感知接到意图交换、联合规划和共享世界状态，了解协同驾驶如何从特征融合走向多主体系统；主体检索覆盖到 2026 年 5 月。

reality-gap-survey-2026.title: The Reality Gap in Automated Driving Systems Testing: Landscape, Challenges, and Research Directions
reality-gap-survey-2026.authors: Stefano Carlo Lambertenghi, Oliver Weissl, Johannes Betz, Andrea Stocco
reality-gap-survey-2026.readingNote: 近期补充：按仿真组件、现实参照和评测指标拆解 sim-to-real 差距，适合理解仿真结果与真实驾驶行为之间缺哪类对应证据。

simulators-survey-2024.title: Choose Your Simulator Wisely: A Review on Open-Source Simulators for Autonomous Driving
simulators-survey-2024.authors: Yueyuan Li, Wei Yuan, Songan Zhang, Weihao Yan, Qiyuan Shen, Chunxiang Wang, Ming Yang
simulators-survey-2024.readingNote: 按交通流、传感器、驾驶策略和车辆动力学任务比较开源仿真器，适合先确定测试所需能力。软件列表反映当时版本，具体功能与维护状态需查看当前项目。

physical-ads-attacks-survey-2025.title: Adversarial Attacks on Autonomous Driving Systems in the Physical World: A Survey
physical-ads-attacks-survey-2025.authors: Lijun Chi, Mounira Msahli, Qingjie Zhang, Han Qiu, Tianwei Zhang, Gerard Memmi, Meikang Qiu
physical-ads-attacks-survey-2025.readingNote: 按攻击场景、生成因素、受害任务和物理形式整理感知攻击，便于比较贴片、光学欺骗与点云干扰。重点在物理世界的感知攻击，车内网络等威胁需另读专项资料。

ai-security-risk-review-2024.title: A qualitative AI security risk assessment of autonomous vehicles
ai-security-risk-review-2024.readingNote: 跨感知、规划和端到端模型整理对抗样本、后门、隐私与模型窃取，用攻击所需资源和暴露条件分析风险。适合补充物理攻击综述的范围；风险评估采用定性尺度。

3d-ood-review-2026.title: Out-of-distribution detection in 3D applications: A review
3d-ood-review-2026.authors: Zizhao Li, Xueyang Kang, Joseph West, Kourosh Khoshelham
3d-ood-review-2026.readingNote: 近期补充：把 OOD 检测接到三维数据，查看几何稀疏性、数据模态和不确定性校准带来的差异。覆盖医疗、工业等多种应用，道路 LiDAR 只是其中一部分。

survey2025-2025.title: Out-of-Distribution Segmentation in Autonomous Driving: Problems and State of the Art
survey2025-2025.authors: Youssef Shoeb, Azarm Nowzad, Hanno Gottschalk
survey2025-2025.readingNote: 从道路障碍分割解释像素级与连通区域指标的差异，并比较额外异常数据的作用。实验以 RGB 图像为主，适合借鉴评测设计，表中性能不对应 LiDAR 结果。
